verdict.rationale: Finding pages similar to a URL is a fair question for a web search API, so the axis applies. The evidence documents query-based ranked search, domain filtering, URL fetch and an embeddings endpoint, but no endpoint that takes a URL and returns similar pages. Embeddings are a developer building block and URL fetch is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can find pages similar to a URL I already have
